note: Opt-in only. `design_index.py --refresh` applies manual_entries via INSERT OR REPLACE. The baked dataset stays canonical; nothing here runs automatically or scrapes the network (Q1: hybrid baked + explicit refresh).

manual_entries.name: Text Bevel Effect — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text bevel gradient background-clip title differentiation hero qualifier
manual_entries.use_case: differentiate two words in one hero title/wordmark that carry distinct roles or identities (base product name + variant/qualifier); hero titles and logotypes only, never body text or functional UI
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: background-clip:text over a vertical gradient across two tokens of the same hue (--color-X dark top/bottom, --color-X-light at 50%); base color is the dark token, light only shows at center; encapsulate in a reusable component, verify WCAG AA contrast in light and dark mode before shipping

manual_entries.name: Gradient Text — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text gradient background-clip parent pattern hero wordmark
manual_entries.use_case: parent pattern for any text fill needing two or more brand tones in one block, before applying a specific variant (bevel, metallic, stroke); never body text or a variable/unpredictable background
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: background-clip:text + color:transparent over a linear-gradient background; verify contrast at the lightest point of the gradient, not the average

manual_entries.name: Metallic/Chrome Text — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text metallic chrome gold silver copper gradient wordmark premium
manual_entries.use_case: single-word premium wordmark wanting a physical-material feel (gold/silver/copper); never multi-word or minimalist-tech brands
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: 4-6 stop gradient alternating light (specular highlight) and dark (metal shadow) zones over background-clip:text, one named stop set per metal variant

manual_entries.name: Gradient Stroke Text — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text stroke outline gradient hollow title variable-background
manual_entries.use_case: large titles over a variable background (photo/video/animated gradient) where a solid text fill would compete visually; never small sizes or body text
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: -webkit-text-stroke for the outline combined with background-clip:text so the stroke itself carries the gradient; treat as progressive enhancement, no unprefixed standard equivalent exists

manual_entries.name: Glow/Neon Text — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text glow neon text-shadow pulse tech gaming
manual_entries.use_case: tech/gaming/nightlife brand identity or punctual hover/active states; never functional UI (buttons, labels, inputs) or corporate-serious brands
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: multiple stacked text-shadow layers of increasing radius, same hue, optionally pulsed via @keyframes; respect prefers-reduced-motion if animated

manual_entries.name: Image/Video-Filled Text — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text mask image video fill hero clip-path
manual_entries.use_case: single-brand hero headline where the product photo/video is the content and the text is the frame revealing it; never dynamic/i18n text or contexts requiring guaranteed legibility
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: background-clip:text with an image background, or mask-image/SVG mask to clip a <video> to the text shape; structurally high WCAG risk since contrast depends on asset content, not a controlled token

manual_entries.name: Holographic/Iridescent Foil Text — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding text holographic iridescent foil animated gradient premium collectible
manual_entries.use_case: premium/collectible brand positioning (limited drop, collectible gaming) where the foil-card effect is expected; never sustained-reading contexts or minimalist/corporate brands
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: animated multicolor gradient over background-clip:text, background-position shifted in a loop; verify contrast at the WORST frame of the animation cycle, respect prefers-reduced-motion by freezing on a valid frame

manual_entries.name: Duotone Image Overlay — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding image duotone photography overlay two-tone filter
manual_entries.use_case: consistent brand photography treatment across editorial/product images (the Spotify pattern); never when the real product color is itself information (fashion/cosmetics e-commerce)
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: SVG feColorMatrix/feComponentTransfer mapping image shadows to a dark brand token and highlights to a light brand token, replacing the full tonal range with two colors

manual_entries.name: Variable Font Weight/Width Animation — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding typography kinetic variable-font animation wordmark motion
manual_entries.use_case: brand wanting a kinetic wordmark that breathes/reacts on hover, scroll, or load; requires a real variable font file with the needed axes — verify before committing; never extended reading text
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: animate font-variation-settings (wght/wdth axes) via CSS transition or scroll-link; respect prefers-reduced-motion for continuous or large-amplitude animation

manual_entries.name: Scroll-Driven Reveal — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding motion scroll animation-timeline view zero-js reveal
manual_entries.use_case: reveal a logo/brand section/hero block as it enters viewport without scroll-listener JS; Safari has no support at all — mandatory static fallback
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: animation-timeline: view() + animation-range (e.g. entry 0% entry 40%); use scroll() instead for whole-container progress (parallax/progress bars)

manual_entries.name: Animated Grainy Texture — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding surface noise grain texture animated mix-blend-mode background
manual_entries.use_case: hero section background that feels too flat/digital as a solid gradient; never behind reading text or as multiple simultaneous instances (repaint cost)
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: SVG feTurbulence (Perlin noise) or an abused CSS gradient, overlaid via mix-blend-mode:overlay, with background-position animated in a loop

manual_entries.name: OKLCH + color-mix() Dynamic Brand Tinting — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding color tokens oklch color-mix dynamic theming hover states design-system
manual_entries.use_case: any brand token system hardcoding separate hover/active/tint colors instead of deriving them from one base token; never for colors already certified exact by external guidelines (e.g. logo Pantone)
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: define one brand token in OKLCH, derive hover/active/tint/focus states via color-mix(in oklch, ...) against white/black/another token instead of storing a token per state

manual_entries.name: Adaptive SVG Favicon — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding favicon adaptive dark-mode light-mode svg prefers-color-scheme
manual_entries.use_case: any public-facing brand needing tab legibility in both OS light and dark themes; skip for internal dev tools/CLIs/dashboards where the friction isn't worth it
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: SVG favicon with an embedded <style>+@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block; Safari does not support the auto-switch, requires a fixed ICO/PNG fallback

manual_entries.name: Glassmorphism Brand Card — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding surface glassmorphism backdrop-filter blur card texture
manual_entries.use_case: brand cards/panels placed over a gradient or image background where the blur has content behind it to act on; never over a flat/solid background or as many large stacked panels (performance)
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: backdrop-filter:blur(8-20px) over a translucent rgba() panel with a 1px near-transparent hairline border; requires -webkit-backdrop-filter for Safari, verify text contrast against the worst-case content behind the panel

manual_entries.name: Grainy Gradient Background — Power Pack
manual_entries.tags: branding surface noise grain texture static gradient background
manual_entries.use_case: replace a flat brand gradient with a subtly textured one without photography, at lower performance cost than the animated variant; never on small surfaces (buttons/badges) or mixed with an animated version in the same view
manual_entries.pattern_snippet: solid brand gradient (linear/radial) plus a static SVG feTurbulence noise layer blended via mix-blend-mode, no animation
